_comment: Mutations for the Rust Sentinel AI agent, scored against agent_run.sh — both agents against one Command Center and one scripted model, on all three wires. `restart_rust` is false because agent_run.sh builds and restarts its own processes. The harness has four named divergences (frame order, the OpenAI 5xx retry, the replay of malformed arguments, list order); none of the mutations below should be able to hide behind one.

mutations.name: trace result cut at 900, not 800
mutations._why: The trace is stored on the run row and has a budget; the cut is on the wire to Command Center.

mutations.name: a filed run with no severity defaults to medium
mutations._why: Only reachable when the model files without a valid severity.

mutations.name: a filed incident is reported as no_action
mutations._why: The dashboard's run history and the monthly counters key on this.

mutations.name: an empty answer has an empty summary
mutations._why: The placeholder is what the operator reads.
mutations.old:
summary: if summary.is_empty() {
                    "(agent returned no summary)".to_string()

mutations.name: finalize_incident no longer carries the incident id
mutations._why: Most-recent-write-wins across two tools; dropping one changes which incident a run points at only when finalize is the last word.

mutations.name: stale frames are never pruned
mutations._why: Every frame ever captured would ride along on every later request — context and cost, invisible in the outcome.

mutations.name: a cutoff after filing loses its suffix
mutations.old: summary: format!("{summary} An incident was filed before the cutoff."),

mutations.name: an invalid severity is accepted
mutations._why: Command Center validates severity on /complete; an unvalidated one turns a finished run into a 422.

mutations.name: one iteration too many
mutations._why: The budget is the cost ceiling.

mutations.name: long string arguments are cut at 100
the org override header is not sent
mutations._why: The first-party key is multi-tenant: without the header the tools have no org, or the wrong one.

mutations.name: a pruned message carries no notice
mutations._why: The notice is what tells the model the frames were there.

mutations.name: max_tokens is not sent
mutations._why: A missing cap is a provider default, which is a different bill.

mutations.name: malformed arguments are not repaired
mutations._why: Without the repair one bad tool call ends the run as a provider error.

mutations.name: an empty model turn is a failure
every trigger gets the manual brief
a null severity is sent rather than omitted
